get_model_from_args: load a pre-trained or local denoiser model using argparse args with dns48 dns64 master64 or valentini_nc flags
dns48_pretrained: create a pre-trained Demucs denoiser model with hidden size 48 trained on DNS data
dns64_pretrained: create a pre-trained Demucs denoiser model with hidden size 64 trained on DNS data
master64_pretrained: create a pre-trained Demucs denoiser model with hidden size 64 trained on DNS and Valentini data
add_model_flags: add mutually exclusive argparse flags for selecting a denoiser model path or pre-trained variant
